key_finding: `build_repository_graph` (core/src/graph/engineering_graph.rs) computes each `DocumentSection` node's id as `stable_id("node", &format!("document-section:{}:{heading}", document.path))` -- `document.path` and `heading` joined with a bare `:`, no escaping. Two structurally different documents -- `{path: "docs/a.md", heading: "b.md:Overview"}` and `{path: "docs/a.md:b.md", heading: "Overview"}` -- render to the byte-identical join `"docs/a.md:b.md:Overview"`, confirmed by direct execution against the real, unfixed implementation: both collapsed onto a single `DocumentSection` node instead of two. `heading` is raw markdown heading text (`adapter::markdown_headings`: `line.trim_start_matches('#').trim()`, no charset restriction) and `document.path` is a real filesystem path (Unix permits `:` in filenames, and this extractor never validates against that).
